title: A grammar for knowledge
concept: An editorial typesetting surface makes ontology legible as language. Five spatial frames establish distinct categories; a family name and an individual member reveal class versus instance; subject, relation and object then assemble into a readable claim. Selecting equipment, method or evidence changes which existing statement and entry token receives emphasis. A separate provenance and review composition keeps a recorded source relation from appearing to prove applicability. All diagram data is illustrative, not performed engineering.
metaphor: A composing stick for engineering language: framed nouns, italic verbs, a full stop held open for review.
choreography: Five category words arrive on staggered baselines; their bracket-like rules establish distinct semantic spaces.
The Pump type is set first; the dot-marked Pump A instance follows below, with an instance-of relation between them.
A subject, named relation and object typeset in sequence along a stepped reading path; the chosen entry becomes reversed type.
An illustrative reference is placed in a provenance column while a dashed PENDING mark appears in a separate applicability column.
The final claim enlarges into three typographic lines; typed terms, named relation and pending status remain inspectable together.
interaction: Equipment reveals Head balance applies to Pump A; Method reveals Head balance requires input Flow condition; Evidence reveals Head balance supported by Reference excerpt. The relevant entry word receives solid-color emphasis. These are three views over the same authored examples, not changed facts or reviewed applicability.
contributions: A reusable semantic sentence layout using category brackets, italic relation verbs and a solid instance dot.
Entry-dependent sentence selection that is meaningful without a hub graph or dense cards.
A separate visual treatment for provenance records and unresolved applicability, with finite replayable motion and authored Korean translations.
limitations: All terms, relations and reference excerpts are illustrative; no source document was retrieved and no engineering calculation or applicability assessment was performed.
The example exposes only the supplied type, instance, method, input and evidence; it is not a complete ontology editor.
The pure SVG states and translation coverage are locally verifiable; target-browser rendering and reader comprehension require the shared host review.
